_note: Plug states for the sandbox (setup_web.py scenario NAME --to staging/sandbox). Each scenario sets FakePlug / FakeDimmerPlug options on the named plug (by role, so it works with any seeded array) and may add extra fakes. Options: ok (false = offline), stuck (command accepted, state unchanged), fail_set (command raises), on, power_w, expect_w, revert_s (countdown armed after OFF), level. Restart sandbox-tank after switching: it loads the array at start.

white_offline.desc: the white lamp plug drops off Wi-Fi

white_plus_stuck.desc: the 200 W plug accepts commands but its relay never moves

blue_fails.desc: every command to the blue plug errors

moon_stuck_on.desc: the moon dimmer is on and ignores commands (no backstop on dimmers)

watts_while_off.desc: white reads OFF but draws power (stuck relay or wrong dp)

heater_countdown_disarmed.desc: a heater gate plug is OFF with no countdown armed (power cut with power-on OFF)

everything_wrong.desc: all of the above at once
